primary_claim: A gradually-escalating, multi-turn poem-prompting jailbreak (APIAYN), combined with word misspellings, elicits profanity, sexually explicit content, and hazardous information from ChatGPT (GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini), Meta AI (Llama 3.1), and Mixtral 8x7b, but fails against Claude Haiku, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini Free Tier.

effect.value: worked on ChatGPT (GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini), Meta AI/Llama 3.1, Mixtral 8x7b; failed on Claude Haiku, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini Free Tier

stated_future_work: Extend a long conversation before APIAYN is brought in to make it operate more efficiently
A future post on countering APIAYN variants using instability-in-prompt-context solutions
Test whether combining discarded jailbreaks with gradually-escalating-violation creates other successful variants
limitations_stated: The Intuitions/structure-pointer theory section is highly speculative and lacks empirical evidence
The branches of APIAYN (gradually escalating violation, misspellings) haven't been fully tested in isolation
Uncertain why continuing a jailbroken conversation hours later instantly fails
Uncertain why misspelling-based bypass sometimes gets flagged and sometimes doesn't
quote: As visible, for the models where this works, with nearly zero deception from the prompter, the LLM can be made to generate inappropriate content freely.
